channel.title: All Israel News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from All Israel News (allisraelnews.com)

item.title: Understanding the interception failures in Arad &amp;amp; Dimona: How does the IDF decide which interceptor system to use?
item.description: IDF interception failures in Arad and Dimona raise questions as military explains how it selects Arrow or David’s Sling systems amid evolving missile threats.

item.title: Netanyahu pardon request: Heritage Minister Eliyahu submits opinion paper to President Herzog
item.description: Israeli minister submits opinion on Netanyahu pardon as Herzog resists pressure, including from Trump, vowing to decide solely by law and national interest.

item.title: Untold story of Shulamit Cohen, Mossad spy who operated in the heart of Lebanon
item.description: The untold story of Shulamit Cohen Kishik, the Mossad spy who risked everything inside Lebanon—surviving capture, torture, and a death sentence to return home.

item.title: Miracle amid destruction: Iranian missiles hit Israeli homes, but no lives lost in Arad and Dimona
item.description: Iranian missiles devastate homes in Arad and Dimona, leaving hundreds injured—yet no fatalities, as residents recount survival and resilience.

item.title: Is this Iran's 'Delcy'? Mohammad-Bagher Ghalibaf, the corrupt general turned politician apparently leading talks with the US
item.description: Reports identify Iran’s parliament speaker Ghalibaf as Trump’s mystery contact, but experts warn the IRGC-linked insider is a hardliner, not a reformer.

item.title: Israel halts defense exports to France amid growing diplomatic strains
item.description: Israel halts defense exports to France amid rising tensions, signaling growing distrust despite ongoing cooperation and historically complex bilateral ties.

item.title: IDF eliminates Hezbollah terrorists dressed as paramedics, using ambulances to transport weapons
item.description: IDF says it struck Hezbollah operatives disguised as paramedics using ambulances to transport weapons, accusing the group of violating international law.

item.title: Let my people go: a Passover message for today
item.description: Explores the deeper meaning of “Let my people go,” revealing Passover as a story of purpose, calling, and being sent into God’s destiny.

item.title: PM Netanyahu lists ‘10 plagues’ Israel brought over Iranian regime, while Trump continues to signal quick end to the war
item.description: Netanyahu lists 10 plagues on Iran, highlights Israel’s victory over nuclear, missile threats, as Trump signals a possible swift end to the war.

item.title: 14 Israelis injured in latest ballistic missile attack, as Iran continues using cluster munitions on civilian areas
item.description: 14 Israelis injured as Iran fires ballistic missiles with cluster munitions, hitting Bnei Brak and central Israel, causing multiple hospitalizations.

item.title: After Trump tells allies to ‘get your own oil,’ UAE prepares for military action to open Strait of Hormuz
item.description: UAE prepares for military action to open Strait of Hormuz after Trump urges allies to act, seeking UN backing but ready to move alone.

item.title: As Resurrection Sunday approaches, Christians are not under attack by the Israeli government – that’s a lie spread by Israel’s enemies – here are the facts
item.description: Christians in Israel are safe and free; claims of government attacks are false, while persecution of Christians grows elsewhere in the Middle East.

item.title: PASSOVER PAST &amp; PRESENT: Jesus celebrated Passover – here are 4 reasons Evangelicals would be blessed to do so, too
item.description: Why Evangelical Christians should consider celebrating Passover—exploring its biblical roots, Jesus’ example, and its connection to faith and redemption.

item.title: Amid leadership vacuum, Iranian president &amp; foreign minister attend pro-regime rally in Tehran
item.description: Amid leadership vacuum, Iranian president &amp; foreign minister attend pro-regime rally in Tehran as IRGC controls decisions and Pezeshkian fails to meet Supreme Leader.

item.title: Israel tightens security for Passover and Easter amid ongoing missile threats from Iran
item.description: Israel tightens security for Passover and Easter amid ongoing missile threats from Iran, Hezbollah and the Houthis, limiting travel and religious gatherings.
